headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Jamia rusticates 1 student, suspends 2 amid union poll protest.
KTR extends support to Khammam boy battling brain cancer.
SC refuses to entertain plea for CBI probe into sale of tickets by UP-based political parties.
Indian student groups in London protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
Improve civic infrastructure along Vizianagaram routes to Bhogapuram and Visakhapatnam: CREDAI.
bullets_ur: Jamia ne union polls ehtijaj par 1 talib-e-ilm ko kharij aur 2 ko suspend kar diya.
KTR ne brain cancer se larnay walay Khammam ke larke ki madad ka elaan kiya.
SC ne UP ki siyasi jamaaton ki ticket farokht par CBI jaanch ki darkhwast par sama'at se inkar kiya.
London mein Indian student groups ne CEC Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaf ehtijaj kiya.
Bhogapuram aur Visakhapatnam ke Vizianagaram routes par civic infrastructure behtar kiya jaye: CREDAI.
